diagnosis: The webhook checks the DocuSign cryptographic signature, but marks ContractSigner.is_verified = True using clientSignerId from the envelope's custom fields without verifying that the envelopeId belongs to the contract under which clientSignerId was registered. An attacker who has legitimate access to send DocuSign envelopes can forge clientSignerId to mark unverified signers as legally verified.

corrected_code:
@router.post("/api/v1/webhooks/docusign")
async def docusign_envelope_webhook(
    request: Request,
    x_docusign_signature: str = Header(..., alias="X-DocuSign-Signature-1"),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db)
):
    body = await request.body()
    digest = base64.b64encode(hmac.new(settings.DOCUSIGN_HMAC_KEY.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).digest()).decode()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(digest, x_docusign_signature):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Unauthorized webhook signature")

    data = json.loads(body)
    envelope_summary = data.get("envelopeSummary", {})
    envelope_id = envelope_summary.get("envelopeId")
    recipient_data = envelope_summary.get("recipients", {}).get("signers", [{}])[0]
    signer_record_id = recipient_data.get("customFields", {}).get("clientSignerId")

    stmt = select(ContractSigner).join(Contract).where(
        ContractSigner.id == signer_record_id,
        Contract.docusign_envelope_id == envelope_id
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    signer = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not signer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Signer envelope mismatch or not found")
    signer.signed_at = datetime.utcnow()
    signer.is_verified = True
    await db.commit()
    return {"processed": True}
